messages:
Sara V: Quick check on zeta13b onboarding — HF points to huggingface://org/zeta13b/main/weights.safetensors but our registry expects s3://ri-registry/models/zeta13b/weights.safetensors. Do we have a mirror yet? Also saw a tokenizer vocab mismatch locally. Anyone able to triage?

Mike C: I dug into the manifest — no mirror record in the registry bucket. I can start a mirror job but we need the HF checksum to match our expected digest. HF sha256 reported: `sha256: a3f4c9...` but our registry manifest references `sha256: 7b2e1d...`. Did someone re-quantize the artifact or rename files?

Alin P: Tokenizer note: HF's vocab.json has 50257 tokens; our tokenization tests expect 50256 (we drop `` in some forks). That leads to off-by-one token ids in the eval prompts. I can run a quick script to validate mapping and emit a fixmap. Recommend running `scripts/tokenizer-check.py --hf-path hf://org/zeta13b --registry-path s3://ri-registry/models/zeta13b` before mirroring.

Mike C: Good call. Also when mirroring, use the multipart copy to preserve checksums. Example command I use for dryrun: ```aws s3 cp s3://hf-cache/zeta13b/weights.safetensors s3://ri-registry/models/zeta13b/ --metadata-checksum sha256=auto --acl bucket-owner-full-control``` That preserves etag/metadata we rely on for verification.

Kevin L: I'm getting AccessDenied when trying to read s3://ri-registry/models/zeta13b. @ops-bot / @ops-team can you grant eng-ml read/list for that prefix? I need to fetch the file to run the tokenizer check.

ops-bot: ops-bot: granted s3:GetObject and s3:List to role/team eng-ml for prefix models/zeta13b in ri-registry (temp creds valid 6h). :white_check_mark:

artifact-mirror-bot: artifact-mirror-bot: queued mirror job zeta13b -> ri-registry (job id: mirror-2026-03-15-42). Will report back with post-copy checksum.

Jules R: Heads up — config validation failed in CI: model_config.json has "max_sequence_length": 2048 but serving spec expects 4096 for the -long variant. If we mirror the shorter weights into a long-serving slot we'll hit KV-cache size mismatch and kernels may OOM. Either update model_config or mark as zeta13b-short in registry metadata.

Sara V: Plan: Mike — please wait for Alin's tokenizer-check to finish and for ops-bot access confirmation, then run the mirrored copy with the multipart command. Jules — open a small PR to align model_config or add a serving-variant tag. I'll collect the digest we expect and update the manifest. Once mirror job finishes, artifact-mirror-bot, can you attach the final sha256 and a presigned URL?

Mike C: Roger. I'll hold the mirror until Alin signals. Also can we bump presign TTL to 24h for the ingest step? Current default 1h is too short for our manual QA loop.

Alin P: Running tokenizer-check now. If mapping diffs are small I'll push a fixmap under `registry/patches/zeta13b/tokenizer-fixmap.json` and attach to the manifest. ETA ~25m.

artifact-mirror-bot: artifact-mirror-bot: mirror job mirror-2026-03-15-42 completed. post-copy sha256: a3f4c9b2d9e8f4c3e... Presigned GET: https://ri-registry.s3.amazonaws.com/models/zeta13b/weights.safetensors?X-Amz-Expires=86400

Kevin L: Verified I can download and run `sha256sum` — matches a3f4c9b2... :thumbsup: Also ran tokenizer-check against the mirrored file; mapping diff was just the trailing special token. Alin's fixmap applied cleanly.

Jules R: Updated PR #452 to set max_sequence_length to 4096 for the zeta13b-long variant and added a CI guard that fails if manifest.variant != serving-variant.

Sara V: Awesome — thanks all. I'll update the onboarding checklist and close the loop once the PR is merged and mirror checksum is in the manifest. If anything slips, ping here. :raised_hands:
